translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Pi mangami.
Tsaaren Diosya naa Noénu bain, naa yaba bulu baakusha pumu jeen animaalanu bain, naa cha' miyanuu animaalanu bain pashindyumi. Tsejtu ishuwa tusha juyikaañu pi umaa mangandundami.
Tsenñu naa pi tainsha tu leetse'ke' pi faanu juru bain demallukikemi, tsejtu naa kai'sha selusha leetseta juru bain demallu'ñu, umaa shuwa bain mandyami.
Tsenñu umaa pi jayu jayu mangantsumi. Tsejtu shuwa jadunda' dya'ka' pi demangainshabi 150 malu wanbimi.
Tsejtu mandishpai chu'chaya insha, 17 malusha juntsa baaku Ararat kuyitala tsui ejkemi.
Tsenñun pi manganchi ne kikentsuñu' mitya, paitya chu'chaya insha, ajke' malunu aa katyu kuyilaya yumaa mangatawantsula.
Tsenñu bene 40 malusha, Noé baakunu ke'laadinu juukapa juuke',
ma kuerbu tyaike' je'ware' eemi; tsenñu kuerbuya tu me-ejkenbera keenatu nukaba ne je'danda kes neintsumi.
Tsenñu bene Noé palumanaa mandyaike' eemi, yumaa pi mangantsuñuba mijanu tyatu;
tsenñuren pi bu'nañu' mitya paluma baakusharen miimi nukaba chudi' lekakenuu tena katai'tu. Tsenñu Noé tyaapa usake' manchujtikaatu, baaku juusha manga' pumi palumanu.
Tsejtu Noé mandishpai malu kayu mangueeditu, manen palumanu mandyaike' eemi.
Tsenñu yumaa ma deyapijuru' kakinsha paluma, ya' fi'papanu ulibu chi tape majkaaya miimi. Tsaiñaa Noé, naa tu yumaa demafalentsuñuba mijami.
Tsejtu mandishpai malu kayu mangueeditu manen palumanu me-eemi; tsenñuren paluma umaa maatyumi.
Tsenñu Noé yumaa 601 añu juunu malunaa tu deme-ejkemi. Tsejtu juntsa añu ajke' malunu Noé baaku mishbui'sha juuke' ke-eetu, tu deme-ejkee katami.
Tsa' mitya kasa añu manchañu, ma chu'chaya, 27 malusha yumaa narai deme-ejkemi.
Tsenñu Noénu Dios tsandimi:
Ñu bain, ñu' shinbu bain, ñu' nala bain, naa ñu' suyala bain maludei.

Tsenmin kumuinchi ñuba bulu pumu animaalanu, naa pishkulanu bain, naa cha' miyanuu animaalanu bain, naa ajkachi shilla' neimu animaalanu bain demangalaade, yai bain entsa tunu nukaba deji', na miyandi' deseengue', entsa tunu pure' serainudetsu, timi.
Tsenñu Noé ya' shinbuba, naa ya' nala bain, naa ya' suyala bain,
naa animaala bain millai malula; naa cha' miyanuu animaala bain, naa ajara animaala bain, naa ajkachi shilla' neimu animaala bain, naa jekachi neimu animaala bain ma bulu, ma bulu malula.

Tsejtu bene Noé, ufeenda tsure' ju'kenunu main kemi Yavénu ufeenda keewaanu, tsangue' Dioschi ura kuraa animaalanu bain, naa Dioschi ura kuraa pishkulanu bain kaminguetu, detute' ju'ke' Diosnu keewaami.

Tsenñu Yavé juntsa jupe tsamantsa aindyu' ishkaputu tsandimi: Naa-uwanuba cha' ruku' kuipa' mityan entsa tunu firu' isa ti' manban jui'yu, naa chachiya nei'ba unnamiren firu' kenu pensan judeeñuba. Tsenmin naa animaalanu bain challa naake dekike' pire'ba tsa manguen jui'yu, timi.

Tsa' mitya entsa tu naa-uwanuba de-i' piyaindyuya, naa kiya wajnu tinbu bain, naa pu' inu tinbu bain, naa lujaa tennu tinbu bain, naa ishtennu tinbu bain junu tsuve; tsenmin naa shu tinbu bain, naa shu tinbu jutyu bain junu tsuve, tsenmin naa kepe bain, naa mandala bain junu tsuve, timi.
